record.title: Patterson–Wiedemann covering-radius conjecture for binary Reed–Muller codes
record.statement:
For Boolean functions $f,g:\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb F_2$, let
\[
d(f,g)=\#\{y\in\mathbb F_2^n:f(y)\ne g(y)\},
\]
\[
\rho_n=\max_f\min_g d(f,g),
\]
where the maximum is over all Boolean functions $f$ and the minimum is over the $2^{n+1}$ affine Boolean functions $g$. Define
\[
\mu_n=\frac{2^{n/2}-\rho_n}{2^{n/2-1}}.
\]
The Patterson–Wiedemann conjecture was that
\[
\lim_{n\to\infty}\mu_n=1.
\]
record.references: Source: [10.4171/OWR/2019/13](https://ems.press/journals/owr/articles/16775), page 55. Canonicalized from 2 source-backed detection(s); richer provenance is retained in the corpus artifact.
